description: This file defines the CapabilitiesDeserializer class which implements custom JSON deserialization for Capabilities objects, parsing various nested JSON fields related to Nextcloud Notes capabilities and theming options.

classes.name: CapabilitiesDeserializer
classes.description: Implements custom JSON deserialization logic for Capabilities object, extracting version info, theming colors, notes API version, federation sharing, password policies, and direct editing capabilities from a JSON response.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Parses a JSON element to populate a Capabilities object with supported features and properties.

methods.name: hasDirectEditingCapability
methods.description: Checks if the capabilities JSON object indicates support for direct editing with file ID support.
